vm.scope_note: Development scope; no J18 clause is supported. The public cold-boot preview carries ukai-vm and ukai-vm-install; its warm-client experiments used a client built from source. The private Developer-ID-signed 0.1.0-preview.2 package at clean source 9ceada861 includes ukai-jail and its sibling service, but is not notarized or published. Twelve guest requirements are admitted only for the measured guest disk and seed: ten direct capability rows plus derived execution_boundary and vault-only credential_staging. Another image or unmeasured requirement refuses with vm:not-measured:<requirement> before any connection or boot. Unsupported policy fields refuse with vm:not-carried:<field>; the wall must be an explicit 1-300 seconds, and owner-loss termination remains unsupported. The 15 November qualification ledger records exact-source signing, installer, source-rebuild, synthetic credential-source revocation, warm workflow and bounded wall-termination checks; an unknown final guest result is never promoted to clean termination. These are development measurements, not vendor compatibility or full release acceptance. K108.1-K113.1 stay unsupported. version is the public cold-boot preview pinned by the installer; candidate_version is the warm package built by package.py. Publication requires a shipped client and the full K108-K113 rows rerun on the exact notarized and stapled candidate; no guest admission or synthetic probe waives those gates.
